notes.title: Dev update/082025: new tracked chassis Guard
notes.content:
Hi!  

August has been a bit of a vacation month for me — taking time to rest, recharge, and gather fresh ideas for the project. But don’t worry, things have still been moving forward! 

 

I’ve been working on a new tracked chassis design.  

Below, you’ll find concept art of the Guard from "Thorva Industries", along with infographics showing the chassis’ capabilities. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583460/a3bf19d21727ba6a2f07eb4b35370609c6e2d903.gif"]
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583460/914f5df890ed774e278ecd1b83a6d2587f34de4a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583460/76aefe2c5d7fa01c1f30f7078b16ec187b0d1b66.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583460/6a1a3b5e44adba6da8cbb39633844ad5e8505bfa.png"][/carousel]
 

It has a simplistic design, but its low profile gives it a real edge in the arena, making it a tricky target to hit.

Take this as your reminder to get some rest too — exciting things are ahead! 

 

Thank you!    







-Alex

notes.title: Dev update/072025: new tracked chassis Patriot
notes.content:
Hi!  

I hope you’re all enjoying the summer season—whether you’re traveling, exploring new destinations, or simply taking time to relax and recharge.

In July, I have been focused on integrating a new type of tracked chassis into the project. 

Below, you will find concept art for the Patriot from "Thorva Industries", accompanied by infographics that illustrate the capabilities of these tracked chassis.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583460/cfec3cde20a8e59b4024c095696e5c413bb41c13.gif"]
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583460/ffaca726ac4c632508a41149a85ec64551a1832b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583460/1cfe6b8dc656122c6fe41e7d07de522f2d7f702a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583460/8a4c5166496c753e466af746a64519d4f8a07d68.png"][/carousel]
These vehicles are designed to be highly durable and exhibit significant resistance to kinetic and explosive damage. 

While their movement speed is limited, they excel in rough terrain traversal, making them particularly effective in adverse weather conditions such as snow, heavy rain, or the rugged landscapes.



Stay tuned for the next update, and feel free to share your thoughts!  

Thank you!    







-Alex
